units: Y. Ab. Zar. II beg. 40ᶜ אוֹהֲבָהּ her lover; a. fr. אוהב את הבריות philanthropist.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:12">Aboth I, 12</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>אָהוּב</he>, f. <he>אֲהוּבָה</he>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 23a">Yeb. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ בנשואיה</he> beloved (worth loving) for her well chosen marriage. [Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>איהבתו</he> read <he>אוֹהַבְתּוֹ</he>.]
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite>, beg., these blows (of persecution) had the effect <he>להֵאָהֵב וכ׳</he> to make me beloved of my Father in heaven.
<cite ref="Yoma 86a:12">Yoma 86ᵃ</cite> <he>שיהא ש״ש מִתְאָהֵב וכ׳</he> that the Divine Name may be beloved through thee (that thy doings may favorably reflect on thy religion).—

senses.gloss: to make beloved, popular. Tan. d’be El. I, 28 תהא מְאָהֵב ש״ש וכ׳ make the Divine Name &c. (v. supra).—Part. Pu. מְאוּהָב popular.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>להַאֲהִיבָן</he> (<he>לאָהֲבָן</he>) <he>לקרבן וכ׳</he> to make them beloved (of God), draw them nigh (to God) &c.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 981:5">Yalk. Cant. 981</cite> <he>הֶאֱהַבְנוּ לך עלמות הרבה</he> we have made many maiden beloved of thee (converted them).
